task: resilience.CircuitBreaker: CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN circuit breaker with single probe, generation-tagged stale-result ignore, injectable Clock
reasoning_summary: State transitions happen under a short lock while the guarded action runs outside it. Each permitted call carries a generation number so results from a call that started before a state change are ignored. Time is an injectable Clock so all deadline tests are exact; concurrency tests use latches to prove one probe at a time and stale-failure immunity.
